name: How should I prepare before hiring a contractor for a walk-in shower remodel?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before hiring a contractor for a walk-in shower remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling an initial consultation, measure your existing bathroom space and decide whether you want to preserve your current footprint or expand into adjacent closets or walls. Collect reference photos of your preferred aesthetic, including tile patterns, niche designs, and fixture finishes. You should also decide early whether your priority is accessibility, a spa-like retreat, or maximizing budget efficiency. Gathering these details helps your remodeling contractor assess structural framing, plumbing alignments, and realistic material allowances during the walk-through.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure your bathroom space, determine desired features like niches or benches, choose your design style, and identify whether accessibility is a primary priority.
